name: Query operations strictly scoped by tenant
title: SC-03-01-01 Query operations strictly scoped by tenant
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given multiple registered sites in the database
When a Site Manager queries units or finances
Then queries only return records matching the manager's site_id
And no cross-tenant data leakage is possible
